ObservedRequest.description: One request a page host received, as `GET /observations` lists it.

body.description:
The bytes of its bodies alone, received and sent: the same for
every client that sends and receives the same bodies.

bytes.description: The bytes received and sent for it.

cookies.description: Its cookies, in the order sent.

delivery.description: What the raw server sent of the answer, for the hosts it answers.

headers.description: Every other header, in the order sent, names as sent.

host.description: The host name it named, without the port.

http2.description: Its HTTP/2 connection's settings and its stream, over HTTP/2.

message_signature.description: Its HTTP Message Signatures headers (RFC 9421), when signed.

next_request.description: The next request the same host received, and how long after.

pseudo_header_order.description: HTTP/2's pseudo-header names in the order sent.

repeats.description:
The latest earlier request of the same host, method and target
this one repeats.

sequence.description: Its place among every request, from 0.

status.description: Its answer's status, once the answer's head left.

target.description: Its target: the path and query.

task.description: The task of the host it came to, if the host has one.

timing.description: When it arrived and was answered.

tls.description: The TLS `ClientHello` of its connection, over TLS.

RequestTiming.description:
When a request's head arrived and its answer's head left, in
microseconds since `serve` started.

answered_microseconds.description: When its answer's head left; none while it has not.

description:
What `GET /observations` serves: the requests, typed, and the rest of
the record (the Effects, the reports, the findings, the bytes per task
and per host, the TLS handshakes and the connection record) by name.

requests.description: Every request its page hosts received, in arrival order.

unrecorded_requests.description: How many requests came past the record's bound.

title: Observations
